title: Link expiry, and clicks lost on restart
intent: Add an optional expiry to links so that a redirect stops at a chosen moment while the link's record and statistics stay readable, and fix the loss of buffered click events when the service shuts down. Both must be additive: no existing link, client or stored row may change behaviour.

functionalRequirements.statement: A link can be created with an optional expiry, given either as an absolute time or as a time-to-live.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: expiresAt accepts an ISO-8601 time with a time zone; it is stored and returned in UTC.
ttlSeconds sets the expiry that many seconds after creation.

An invalid expiry returns 400: a time that is not in the future, both fields at once, a value that is not a timestamp or has no time zone, or a time-to-live that is zero, negative, fractional or above the maximum.
A link created without an expiry reports expiresAt as null and never expires.

functionalRequirements.statement: An expired link no longer redirects, and says so.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The link redirects normally up to, but not including, its expiry instant.
From the expiry instant the redirect returns 410 Gone as a problem document with code link_expired and no Location header.
A request to an expired link is not counted as a click.

functionalRequirements.statement: An expired link remains a readable record.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The link's metadata and its statistics are still returned after it has expired.
The alias of an expired link cannot be registered again.

functionalRequirements.statement: BUG-17: clicks accepted before a graceful shutdown are not lost.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Clicks still buffered when the application closes are written to the database before it closes.
Shutdown completes even if that final write fails.

functionalRequirements.statement: Existing links and clients are unaffected.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A link stored before this change still redirects and reports expiresAt as null.
Responses keep every existing field with its existing meaning; the only change is the added expiresAt field.

nonFunctionalRequirements.statement: The schema change is additive and leaves existing rows untouched.
The redirect path gains no additional database query.

ambiguities.term: told the link has expired rather than that it never existed
ambiguities.question: Which response distinguishes an expired link from an unknown one?
ambiguities.whyItMatters: It is a public contract that clients and monitoring will depend on.
options: An HTML page explaining the expiry
ambiguities.defaultAssumption: 410 Gone as a problem document with code link_expired, consistent with the API's existing error format.

ambiguities.question: Is the link still valid at exactly the expiry instant?
ambiguities.whyItMatters: The boundary has to be defined for the tests to be exact and for clients to predict behaviour.
options: Still valid at the instant, expired after it
ambiguities.defaultAssumption: The link is expired from its expiry instant onwards.

ambiguities.question: Is there an upper bound on the lifetime?
ambiguities.whyItMatters: An unbounded integer invites overflow and nonsensical dates.
ambiguities.defaultAssumption: A positive whole number of seconds, at most five years.

ambiguities.question: May the alias of an expired link be reused for a new link?
ambiguities.whyItMatters: If it can, someone else can register the alias of a link people already trust and send its visitors anywhere.
ambiguities.defaultAssumption: The alias stays reserved, to prevent takeover of an expired link.

ambiguities.question: Does the fix have to cover an abrupt kill of the process, or only a graceful shutdown?
ambiguities.whyItMatters: A deployment sends SIGTERM and is a graceful shutdown. Surviving an abrupt kill needs every click written durably before the redirect returns, which contradicts the existing requirement that recording a click never slows a redirect.
options: Also survive a crash, by writing each click synchronously
ambiguities.defaultAssumption: Graceful shutdown only, which is what a deployment is. Loss on an abrupt kill remains and is documented.

assumptions.statement: Expired links are kept, not deleted, so that their statistics remain available.
Expiry is checked when a link is resolved, using the row already loaded for the redirect.

outOfScope: Changing or removing the expiry of an existing link
Deleting expired links or their click events
Durable click recording that survives an abrupt process kill
